name: Dukaan
summary: Android v0.5.0 is published with searchable categories, responsive indexed reference search, read-only product/discount views and related-product browsing. The README’s first link downloads the latest APK. The web preview remains an independent localhost catalog; stored prices, stock status and product identities remain intact.

tracks.name: Android app
tracks.summary: Published build supports read-only product/discount views, explicit price editing and related-product links. Reference indexing/filtering runs off the UI thread. Source pictures, display modes, category browsing, backup and catalog boundaries remain intact.

tracks.name: Local web preview
tracks.summary: Stable reference input with a cached index and debounced result-only rendering. Read-only price/discount views, related-product browsing, searchable categories and batches of 36 cards. Independent browser storage with English/Hindi/Hinglish modes.

tracks.name: Release
tracks.summary: GitHub hosts the 0.5.0 debug APK and SHA-256 file, including the latest category, search, price-view and related-product changes. The README’s first link downloads this APK. Source and project history are on main.

tracks.name: Shop validation
tracks.summary: Daily counter use, actual catalog quality, phone speech service and real-device performance still need a trial.

tracks.name: Project memory
tracks.summary: One workflow for Codex/Claude, append-only outcomes and ADRs, generated Markdown and the read-only project cockpit. Source is published; a real Claude Code session remains untested.

lanes.title: Android · the daily shop app
lanes.summary: Local lookups and manual edits need no internet. Only explicit language-understanding requests go online.

nodes.title: Compose screens
nodes.detail: Search, manual editing, reviewed AI entry and price cards. Cropping and discount calculations run locally. Product views, temporary discount quotes and related-product links do not save edits.

nodes.title: Room + FTS4
nodes.detail: Local items, aliases, sizes, prices in paise, history and search misses.

nodes.title: OpenAI client
nodes.detail: Responses API with strict JSON schemas; results go to review before saving. Explicit image parsing and category suggestions return to editable review.

nodes.title: Android Keystore
nodes.detail: Encrypts the phone’s API key; no key is bundled in the APK.

nodes.title: App-private photos + ZIP
nodes.detail: Photos and version 2 ZIP backups retain reference links. Validated restore accepts versions 1 and 2; no static reference duplication or credentials.

nodes.title: OpenAI Responses
nodes.detail: Receives explicitly submitted text/images for parsing or categorization; query rewriting also receives category names.

nodes.title: Reference JSON + original PDF
nodes.detail: Immutable Prince source library with unconfirmed stock, source rates/dates and page provenance. Selection opens editable review with blank shop price/unit; only confirmed variants enter Room with unique source links. A separate source-hash-bound image manifest supplies matched table pictures; owner photos take priority. A normalized search index is built and filtered on Dispatchers.Default, separately from the input state.

lanes.title: Web · the localhost preview
lanes.summary: A separate preview on this computer. Browser data is not synchronized with Android.

nodes.title: Browser UI
nodes.detail: Dependency-free HTML/CSS/JS with editable demo items and real workflows. Cropping and discount calculations run locally. Reference typing keeps a stable input and updates a debounced indexed-results region; product views and quote discounts remain read-only.

nodes.title: Browser IndexedDB
nodes.detail: Separate browser catalog and history; clearly labeled sample items.

nodes.title: Local Node server
nodes.detail: Binds to 127.0.0.1. Sends AI requests while keeping the development key server-side. Explicit image parsing and category suggestions return to editable review.

nodes.title: Ignored local key
nodes.detail: Loaded from the process environment or .env.local; never served to browser JavaScript.

nodes.title: Browser JSON backup
nodes.detail: Web-preview-only export and restore; not the Android ZIP format.

nodes.title: OpenAI Responses
nodes.detail: Receives explicitly submitted text/images for parsing or categorization; query rewriting also receives category names.

nodes.title: Separate reference library
nodes.detail: Reads shared source JSON and local PDF/page images through fixed allowlisted routes. Selected variants require blank-price/unit review; only confirmed shop variants enter IndexedDB. A separate source-hash-bound image manifest supplies matched table pictures; owner photos take priority.

boundaries: Prices belong to size/unit variants and are integer paise. GST is an explicit label, not inferred tax.
AI parsing never writes catalog data; the user edits and confirms the review first.
Android and web catalogs are independent. Their backups are not interchangeable.
Schemas and listing instructions are shared from app/src/main/assets/.
Project history is repository documentation; it does not contain API keys, private customer data or the shop catalog.
The /project cockpit reads allowlisted project documentation. It has no catalog-writing or file-editing API.
Images are cropped locally and sent to AI only for an explicit Review items or Suggest category request. Missing or unreadable prices must be reviewed and entered before saving.
Discount percentages are a one-time calculator, not a persistent pricing rule: only the rounded net selling price is saved. Reopening an editor starts from that price without reapplying the discount.

A manufacturer pricelist never proves shop stock or selling prices. Reference variants start unconfirmed and hidden from shop search. Only explicit owner confirmation creates carried shop variants; quantities remain unknown. See ADR-007.

Display languages never rewrite catalog facts. Shared local translations and aliases preserve source IDs, technical specifications and canonical units. Original source text and custom item names remain available. See ADR-008.
